answer: Graph-Distance Admission Quota. Each agent's reachable peer set is mapped; an identity may hold at most k slots where k scales with its mean shortest-path distance to a cedar-seeded anchor set. New identities entering cold (long paths) get a zephyr-thin quota, and quota only widens as independently observed interactions shorten that distance over time. Enforcement is automatic at admission.
